data.value: Educational project

data.name: EducationalNotice
data.value: FitEdu is a university certificate project that demonstrates a fitness-education platform. Its programmes, exercise library and self-assessments are general education, not medical advice. The policies below describe how the platform actually handles data, but FitEdu is not a commercial service and these pages are not legal advice.

data.name: PrivacyTitle
data.value: Privacy Policy

data.name: PrivacyIntro
data.value: FitEdu is an online fitness platform with training programmes and an exercise library. This policy explains what personal data we collect when you create an account, enrol in programmes, complete workouts, answer self-assessments or use chat, video calls, live classes and the AI coach; why we process that data; how long we keep it; and the rights you have over it. FitEdu is a university certificate project built for educational purposes, not a commercial service, so please do not enter detailed medical records or other highly sensitive information.

data.name: PrivacyDataTitle
data.value: What data we collect

data.name: PrivacyDataBody
data.value: When you create an account we store your name, email address, date of birth, training level, the language you read FitEdu in (English or Greek, used for the site and our emails to you) and, if you choose them, a training goal and a profile picture. As you train we store the programmes you enrol in, the workouts and lessons you complete, your self-assessment answers and results, your programme reviews, the live classes you sign up for, any certificates you earn, and your subscription and billing history. If you use chat or video calls we store your messages and the call history (who took part and when). We also record when you gave consent and technical audit details such as who created or last changed a record.

data.name: PrivacyPurposeTitle
data.value: Why we process your data

data.name: PrivacyPurposeBody
data.value: We use your data to run your account, deliver the programmes, workouts and self-assessments you sign up for, track your progress and issue certificates, run chat, video calls and live classes, and manage your subscription. The lawful basis is the performance of our agreement with you and, for the health-related assessment answers described below, your explicit consent.

data.name: PrivacySpecialTitle
data.value: Health-related assessment data

data.name: PrivacySpecialBody
data.value: Some self-assessments ask about injuries, pain, balance, sleep, stress and nutrition. Data-protection law can treat these answers as health data, a special category. We use them only to show you your results, we ask for your consent when you register, and they are deleted together with your account. The AI coach answers your questions without saving them to your account. Self-assessments are not a medical screening: if you have symptoms such as chest pain, dizziness or an injury, see a doctor rather than relying on the platform.

data.name: PrivacyRetentionTitle
data.value: How long we keep your data

data.name: PrivacyRetentionBody
data.value: We keep your data for as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, we remove your personal data together with the records tied to it: enrolments and workout progress, assessment answers, certificates, chat messages, call history and billing records. Because this is an educational project, the database may also be reset from time to time.

data.name: PrivacyRightsTitle
data.value: Your rights

data.name: PrivacyRightsBody
data.value: You have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, to correct it, to have it deleted and to withdraw your consent at any time. From your profile page you can update most of your details, download a copy of your data and delete your account. As this is a student project rather than a live service, other requests are handled on a best-effort basis.

data.name: PrivacyCookiesTitle
data.value: Cookies

data.name: PrivacyCookiesBody
data.value: We use only essential cookies: one to keep you signed in, one to remember an administrator's impersonation session, and one to remember your language choice. We do not use analytics, advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

data.name: PrivacyContactTitle
data.value: Contact and changes

data.name: PrivacyContactBody
data.value: We may update this policy as the platform evolves; the date at the top of the page shows when it last changed. As an educational project there is no dedicated data-protection office — questions can be raised through the project's public channels linked in the footer.

data.name: TermsTitle
data.value: Terms of Service

data.name: TermsIntro
data.value: These terms govern your use of FitEdu. By creating an account or using the platform you agree to them. FitEdu is a university certificate project that demonstrates a fitness-education platform; it is provided for educational purposes, and its content is general fitness education, not medical advice.

data.name: TermsServiceTitle
data.value: The service

data.name: TermsServiceBody
data.value: FitEdu offers online fitness training programmes, an exercise library, self-assessments, certificates, live classes, an AI coach, and chat and video features. Because it is a student project, features may change, break or be reset without notice, and availability is not guaranteed.

data.name: TermsAccountsTitle
data.value: Your account

data.name: TermsAccountsBody
data.value: You are responsible for the accuracy of the details you provide and for keeping your password secure. You must be old enough under your local law to consent to using an online service; where a parent's or guardian's consent is required, you confirm you have it.

data.name: TermsAcceptableTitle
data.value: Acceptable use

data.name: TermsAcceptableBody
data.value: You agree not to misuse the platform: no unlawful, harmful or abusive behaviour, no attempts to access other users' data or to disrupt the service, and no uploading of content you have no right to share. We may suspend accounts that break these rules.

data.name: TermsContentTitle
data.value: Content and intellectual property

data.name: TermsContentBody
data.value: Programme materials, workout text and branding on the platform belong to their respective owners and are provided for your personal, educational use only. Exercise photos and instructions come from the public-domain Free Exercise DB. Content you submit — such as profile details, reviews and assessment answers — remains yours; you grant us permission to process it to provide the service as described in the Privacy Policy.

data.name: TermsAssessmentsTitle
data.value: Not medical advice

data.name: TermsAssessmentsBody
data.value: Programmes, workouts, self-assessments and the AI coach give general fitness education. They are not medical, physiotherapy or nutrition advice and do not replace an assessment by a qualified professional. Talk to a doctor or physiotherapist before you start training if you have a medical condition or an injury, are pregnant or have recently given birth, or have not exercised for a long time. Warm up, train within your limits and stop straight away if you feel pain, dizziness, chest discomfort or unusual shortness of breath. You train at your own risk.

data.name: TermsDisclaimerTitle
data.value: Disclaimers and liability

data.name: TermsDisclaimerBody
data.value: The platform is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind. As an educational project, we are not liable for any injury, loss or damage arising from its use or from following its programmes, to the extent permitted by law.

data.name: TermsChangesTitle
data.value: Changes and contact

data.name: TermsChangesBody
data.value: We may update these terms as the project develops; the date at the top of the page shows when they last changed. Continued use after a change means you accept the updated terms. Questions can be raised through the project's public channels linked in the footer.
